photos.desc: A European Brook Lamprey - Lampetra planeri in search of a stone to bring back to the nest. 11th March 2011 - a brook beside the River Itchen at St Cross, just south of Winchester, Hampshire. Immature
This is my first Lamprey photo - at this stage there are only three of the group of five assembled at the nest site. A little predatory fish is hanging around hopefully but it didn't like me watching
